selection_reason: P3 had the best balanced mean k15/k30 trustworthiness among the stable candidates, lower KL than P0, and less aggressive class-silhouette inflation than P4-P7. One unified setting was applied to all models and folds.
software_note: Current sklearn 1.3.2 exposes n_iter instead of max_iter. P3 max_iter=3000 was executed as n_iter=3000.
